output.summary: Visa-exempt foreign nationals normally need an eTA to fly to Canada unless they hold a valid Canadian visa or another exemption.
conditions: Canadian citizens and permanent residents use different documents.

output.summary: Romanian citizens need an electronic passport to use an eTA for air travel to Canada; holders of non-electronic passports need a visitor visa.

output.summary: Visa-waiver travellers normally need an NZeTA before travel and receive a visitor visa on arrival if entry is granted.
conditions: Passport-specific restrictions apply to some nationalities.

output.title: NZeTA or New Zealand transit visa
output.summary: Eligible transit passengers need an NZeTA; other passengers may need a transit visa.
conditions: Visa-free transit is limited to Auckland International Airport and normally no more than 24 hours.

output.title: NZeTA for Auckland transit
output.summary: Transit-visa-waiver passport holders need an NZeTA before passing through Auckland International Airport.
conditions: Transit must remain in Auckland Airport's international transit area and normally cannot exceed 24 hours.
A different New Zealand airport or leaving the transit area requires visitor entry permission.

output.title: Valid passport or national identity card
output.summary: EU citizens and citizens of Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland can travel to Germany with a valid passport or eligible national identity card.
conditions: The travel document must be valid on the day of travel.
Children and minors must have their own passport or eligible identity card.
Temporary border controls and local identity checks can require the document to be presented.

output.title: Verify Schengen passport and visa requirements
output.summary: Non-EU/EEA/Swiss travellers need a qualifying passport for Germany and may also need a Schengen visa; this local snapshot does not infer the visa decision.
conditions: The passport should have been issued within the previous 10 years on entry and normally remain valid for at least 3 months after the planned departure from the EU.
Visa need depends on nationality and can also be affected by residence documents, family status, passport type, purpose and length of stay.
Verify the exact result with the responsible German consulate or the official EU guidance before booking.
